text.en:
Reporting
Requirements.
-The PMO shall submit a report
to the Office of the President (OP), copy furnished the PMS, on the status of the
merger within thirty
(30) days after the effectivity of this Order and every
quarter there~fter or as often as may be required by the OP.
~,

-Repealing
Clause. -EO 372 (s. 1950) and EO 350 (s. 2004)
and all other orders, rules and regulations, and other issuances or parts thereof
which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed, amended
or modified accordingly.
9.
Effectivity.
Executive Order shall take effect
immediately after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of
general circulation.
in the year of our
Done in the City of Manila, this 17thday of NovemberLord,
two thousand and five.
